Seek out the headmaster for a secondary profession.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}
* No secondary profession
* Primary profession not a [[Ranger]]

===Objectives===
* Speak with Headmaster Greico in the Shing Jea Monastery.

===Reward===
* 50 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Go to southeastern [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. The headmasters are gathered in one place.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Master Togo
''If you are interested in taking the Ranger profession as your secondary field of study, then you will need to speak with [[Headmaster Greico]].''

''Greico is a Luxon bound to us only by his sense of duty, else I imagine he would have flown our little coop by now. He is a good fellow and an excellent Ranger. Seek him out in the [[Shing Jea Monastery]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Yes, Master.
| decline = I'm not sure about this.
| ask = If you wish to become a Ranger, find [[Headmaster Greico]] in the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. Now run along and leave me to my work.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Greico
''Greetings. Yes, I can train you in the ways of the Ranger. You'll learn to tame wild beasts to do your bidding, to lay traps and make preparations to enhance your arrows; in short, you will learn to be one with nature and use her powers as though they were yours alone. But this is not a choice to be taken lightly.''
